comparison.objective: Tear a loaded shelf-ready tray's front panel off along its perforation without disturbing the contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization and directionally controlled tearing of packaging.
comparison.success_condition: Panel completely removed only along the perforation; tray and cans remain stable, upright, and released.
comparison.reason: Controlled fracture of deformable packaging around a heavy load does not test collinear guide mating or rolling-element containment.
